evidence.why: Complete frame builder.
Concrete sample/output buffers and handoff ordering.
Auxiliary address getters; B input is notably gated by A callback.

reason: Frame-builder descriptions match literal numeric modes, nonzero input guards, high/low address serialization and fixed flush from entry cursor. Tail is unconditional on normal completion, not after a terminating assertion. Caller grounds buffer roles.
